title: Fix Type View 3D Model Orientation Z-Up to Y-Up
description: 3D models in the Type view are not oriented correctly. compose Z (up) currently maps to Three.js Z (backward) instead of Three.js Y (up). Two bugs: (1) LoadedTypeMesh uses Design's GLTFMesh/FBXMesh/OBJMesh instead of TypeGLTFMesh/TypeFBXMesh/TypeOBJMesh. (2) Type mesh components need toThreeRotation() applied. Also fix Design mesh components which incorrectly apply toComposeRotation() to model geometry.
